description: Full rules for one account: profit targets, daily and maximum loss, drawdown type, minimum days, time limit, consistency rule, payout terms, trading restrictions on record (news, weekends, open losses, short trades), price, the firm's source page, the date checked, recent rule changes and any proof-checked payout reports for the firm. Takes a PropPassCheck account id.
